title: macOS 26.3 decouples Live Activities from the Dynamic Island. All Apple chip Macs now show persistent status indicators in the menu bar
content_md:
macOS 26.3 entkoppelt Live-Aktivitäten von der Dynamic Island. Alle Apple-Chip-Macs zeigen nun persistente Statusanzeigen in der Menüleiste 

via Mastodon https://www.ctsd.de/insights/2026-11-technik-macos-26-3-live-aktivit-ten-ohne-dynamic-island.html
exclude_reason: macOS 26.3 feature change (Live Activities decoupled from Dynamic Island); not a security event, generic product explainer.
